decisions.reason: A simple accessory that builds directly on the firm's coupling and trailer know-how, cheap to maintain and easy to judge from after-sales feedback, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
Box trailers are core to the firm's production expertise and are featured on the home page, so the firm can readily interpret results and keep improving the series.
Car transporters extend existing trailer chassis knowledge to professional users; the related knowledge base supports learning from early results, though the niche makes it somewhat riskier.
A low-bed series sits squarely within the firm's established design and production competence and has prominent home-page placement, so it stays.
High covers are a natural extension of the existing trailer lines, use familiar materials and processes, and add accessory value.
This second box trailer series draws on the same core knowledge and is promoted on the home page, though it could later be merged with B.
